scope: proposed changes to existing services only; not applied

frontend.API_response_requirement: Forward method, raw body, query, Cookie, all Set-Cookie headers and private/no-store; do not redirect or cache private responses

release_boundary: Do not save Render settings, push, merge, run production migrations or deploy before exact release approval. Both services auto-deploy master; backend build currently runs Alembic.
rollback_requirement: Retained security-aware application artifact using current0022 schema and revocation evidence; do not roll back to pre-security application or restore over newer payments. Verify routing and frontend environment together.
